report:
Erhaltene Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Bekannter Patella alta (Insall-Salvati 1,85) sowie unverändert lateralisiert stehende Patella. Im Verlauf progredienter vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt am Patellafirst und der lateralen Facette am unteren Patellapol über ca. 1,5 x 1,0 cm. Angrenzendes intraossäres Reizödem (4/7). Auch an der lateralen Femurfacette teils vollschichtige Chondropathie (7/14). Einzelnes Ossikel im MPFL (7/10). Jedoch kein Hinweis auf eine Diskontinuität des Ligaments.
Femorotibial erhaltener Artikulation. Osteophytäre Anbauten führend am lateralen Femurkondylus (4/18) sowie am lateralen Tibiaplateau (4/19), kleinere Osteophyten auch am medialen Kompartiment sowie femoropatellar.
Lateral femorotibial abschnittsweise ausgedünnter Knorpelbelag, exemplarisch anterioren der Femurkondyle (5/23). Im medialen Kompartiment nach weitestgehend erhaltener Knorpelbelag. Menisci intakt ohne Hinweis auf eine Rissbildung. Das Innenmeniskushinterhorn gering signalangehoben in der PD, DD bei initialen mukoiden Veränderungen. Kreuzbänder ebenfalls intakt. Schmaler Flüssigkeitssaum medial des MCL, DD bei Reizzustand, kein Hinweis auf eine Ruptur. LCL unauffällig.
Geringer Gelenkerguss. Synovia gering verdickt, zu 06/12 minimal progrediente Baker-Zyste (3/97). Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs dejenerasyonuna yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Mediyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesi düzeyinde alt eklem yüzeyiyle ilişkilenen horizontal-oblik longitudinal dejeneratif yırtık ile medyal menisküs gövdesine komşu milimetrik paralabral kistler izleniyor. Diz eklemindeki hafif dereceli trikompartmantal osteoartrit medyal pateller fasetindeki ve medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan kıkırdak dejenerasyonu ve buna eşlik eden milimetrik subkondral fibrovasküler değişiklik ile karakterize. Tibya proksimal metafizinin mediyalindeki intraoseöz kemik adası 6 mm çaplı. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi.Lateral menisküs anterior posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi.Anterior çapraz bağda muskoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Prepatellar çilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlendi.Femur medial kondilde subartiküler fraktür ve komşu kemik iliğinde ödem ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlendi.Tibiafemoral eklem medialinde eklem aralığında hafif daralma ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda fokal incelmeler izlenmektedir.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.SONUÇ: Femur medial kondilde subartiküler fraktür ve komşu kemik iliği ödemi, tibia femoral eklem medialde hafif düzeyde gonartoz , medial ve lateral menisküslerde grade III meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda muskoid dejenerasyon, subrapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit , prepatellar cilt altı dokuda ödem, medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Chondral thinning along the lateral patellar facet with superimposed foci of high-grade fissuring. Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss along the lateral trochlea with subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Intense soft tissue edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

Findings of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with Hoffa's fat pad impingement, mild proximal patellar tendinosis, and grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Findings:  Moderate knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes. Popliteal cyst measuring approximately 6.6 cm in CC dimension.  Intact cruciates and collateral ligaments  Minor mucoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus which is otherwise intact. Horizontal tear of the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a flipped component in the lateral meniscofemoral recess with surrounding soft tissue edema (see image snap shots).  Intact quadriceps and patellar tendons. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  High-grade chondral thinning in the weightbearing portion of the medial tibiofemoral compartment. High-grade chondral thinning and focal full-thickness chondral defects in the weightbearing portion of the lateral tibiofemoral compartment. High-grade chondral thinning and focal full-thickness chondral loss noted along the median patellar ridge with focal underlying bone stress changes.  Bone stress changes are also appreciated in the posterolateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. Tricompartmental marginal osteophyte formation noted, most prominent in the patellofemoral and lateral tibiofemoral compartments 
Conclusion:  Horizontal tear of the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a flipped component in the lateral meniscofemoral recess with surrounding soft tissue edema (see image snap shots).

COMPARISON:[Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Right lateral knee pain, chronic. Suspected lateral meniscal tear/lateral collateral ligament tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus is intact. Horizontal cleavage tear with superior surfacing noted extending through the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is an additional radial tear involving the lateral meniscal body. The latter is unchanged from <[YEAR]>. The former is new since previous study. No lateral meniscal extrusion. The posterior root and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus are intact. Possible additional inferiorly subtle tear at the periphery of the junction of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, also new since previous study.

The anterior cruciate ligament and T2 are intact. Medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. Fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. There is mild lateral patellar subluxation, similar to previous. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 13 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Focal soft tissue articular cartilage central femoral trochlea, also seen present. Mild chondrosis throughout the remainder the patellofemoral compartment. Mild medial and lateral femorotibial chondrosis, slightly progressed when compared to previous. Probable insertional cyst near the anterior cruciate ligament footplate. 

Prominent red marrow, similar to previous. Small knee joint effusion. Regional musculature is within normal limits.

IMPRESSION:
1. Interval development of horizontal cleavage tear extending through the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus without lateral meniscal extrusion. Unchanged radial tear involving the lateral meniscal body. Possible additional inferiorly surfacing oblique tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.
2. Mild to moderate chondrosis has progressed slightly since previous study, and is compatible with evolving mild osteoarthritis of the right knee.
